purpose: Metadata-only readiness screen for the Caldor IR reference candidate; registered before Sentinel catalogue retrieval.
time_gate_rationale: Six hours is a provisional experiment screening cap, not a calibrated physical guarantee; sensitivities are descriptive, never a post-result widening.
selection: All valid audited IR geometries; for each choose nearest footprint-covering same-platform/datatake group by maximum absolute member time gap, then earlier group and datatake ID.
